title: Affiliates
description: Share OpenShip Cloud. Track referrals, renewals and earnings from your account.
unavailable: The affiliate program is not available yet.
joinHint: Create links for eligible Cloud compute plans. Share part of your commission as a customer discount, or keep the full commission.
eligibility: Monthly and annual Cloud compute only. Manage plans, prepaid PAYG and credit top-ups are excluded.
rules: Commission and discount terms are shown before you create a link. Earnings follow verified payments and adjust for refunds. Payouts are reviewed by OpenShip.
paused: Your affiliate access is paused. You can still view your history. Contact support to restore access.
emptyLinks: Create your first link to start referring customers.
emptyCustomers: Customers appear here when they start a checkout with your referral.
emptyPayouts: Once your earnings reach the minimum, request a payout and follow its progress here.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the link manually.
revokeHint: Stop new referrals from this link? Accepted checkouts and existing referrals keep their terms.
requestHint: Cash payouts are approved by OpenShip. We will contact you through your account email to confirm payment details. Never share bank details in referral links.
reservedHint: Pending requests reserve the amount until paid, rejected or canceled. You can cancel before review starts.
budgetHint: The customer discount comes out of your commission budget. Prices and eligibility are checked again at checkout.
createHint: A link for your audience, with terms you control.
referralTitle: You have been invited to OpenShip Cloud
referralHint: Review the final amount and renewal terms before paying. Your referrer may earn a commission from eligible purchases.
referralUnavailable: This referral is unavailable. You can still browse Cloud plans without it.
referralIntro: Choose a plan, sign in, and continue straight to checkout.
referralApplied: Your referral is applied automatically at checkout.
referralNoPlans: No plans currently match this referral.
emptyCustomersTitle: Your referrals, all in one place
stepLinkHint: Choose a plan and share part of your commission as a discount.
stepShareHint: Customers choose a Cloud plan and sign in to checkout.
stepEarnHint: Track verified earnings, then request a reviewed cash payout.
expiryHint: Expiration stops new referrals. Existing customers keep their reward terms.
expiryInvalid: Choose a future date and time.
earningWindow: Commission applies to payments within {months} months of the customer’s first payment.
unavailableHint: Check back later or contact support if you expected access.
allPlansHint: Includes all eligible plans and billing intervals, including future eligible plans.
selectedPlansHint: Only the checked plan and billing combinations can use this link.
selectAtLeastOne: Choose at least one plan and billing interval.
estimatesHint: Earnings shown are per confirmed payment. Final prices and refunds can affect the amount.
choosePlansHint: Commission is added after each confirmed payment, starting with the first. No need to wait for the month or year to end.
payoutAccountHint: Save where you want to receive reviewed manual payouts.
manualPayoutHint: Payouts are sent manually after review. Availability depends on your country and the payment provider. We may contact you to confirm details. Never enter card numbers or passwords.
addAccountHint: Add a recipient account before requesting a payout.
supportedMethodsHint: Choose how to receive your earnings. Every payout is reviewed before it is sent.
bankTransferHint: ACH or wire transfer to your bank.
paypalMethodHint: Receive funds at your PayPal email or PayPal.Me account.
wiseMethodHint: Receive a transfer using your Wise account email.
payoneerMethodHint: Receive payment through a Payoneer payment request.
selectionChanged: Some selected options are no longer available. Review your plan selection.
annualFirstPaymentHint: With this {months}-month reward period, the next yearly renewal is outside the earning window.
